title: How do Americans feel about other G20 countries?
subtitle: Average rating on a feeling thermometer
data:
Australia, 67
Canada, 67
Japan, 65
Italy, 64
U.K., 60
France, 57
Germany, 57
Mexico, 55
South Korea, 55
Brazil, 54
Indonesia, 48
Argentina, 47
South Africa, 47
India, 46
Turkey, 45
China, 37
Saudi Arabia, 36
Russia, 27
note: Thermometer ratings are on a scale of 0–100, where zero is “as cold and negative as possible” and 100 is “as warm and positive as possible.”
source: Pew Research Center survey of U.S. adults conducted Sept. 14–20, 2026.
